# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.

completion:
On the vehicle inspection report, describe the failure.
3. Clearly state what part(s) of the braking system failed.
4. Include specific details.
5. Note any pertinent observations.
6. Refer to any relevant regulations.
7. Annotate the report.
